name: Thunderhawk Saliva Gland
summary: Greater thunderhawks across the Barrens yield the gland Brewmaster Drohn needs to recreate Chen Stormstout's fiery Trogg Ale.

sections.title: A Wild Ingredient
sections.body: Greater thunderhawks hunt across the Barrens' dry savannas. The winged serpents command storms, and the older, more dangerous ones produce a saliva gland rich in natural potency. Travelers steer clear of these deadly beasts. Brewmasters prize the gland as a rare base for exotic drinks.

sections.title: Chen's Secret Recipes
sections.body: Brewmaster Drohn settled outside Ratchet after Chen Stormstout passed through Kalimdor. Drohn studies the wandering brewmaster's ways of fermentation. To brew Trogg Ale, he needs a fresh thunderhawk saliva gland, stormhide lightning glands, and kodo liver. The fiery spirit has a sure kick and is meant to fortify hardy adventurers.

faq.q: Where do you find a Thunderhawk Saliva Gland?
faq.answer: Greater thunderhawks hunt across the Barrens' open savannas, where their saliva glands can be harvested.

faq.q: What is the saliva gland used for?
aliases: what is thunderhawk saliva gland for
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn outside Ratchet needs the gland to brew Trogg Ale, a potent recipe Chen Stormstout left behind.
Brewmaster Drohn lives near Ratchet's port. The wandering traveler Chen Stormstout taught him exotic brewing, and Drohn trades powerful ales to adventurers who brave local wildlife for ingredients.
Chen Stormstout conceived Trogg Ale as a fiercely potent drink. Brewmaster Drohn makes it with a greater thunderhawk's saliva gland, lightning glands, and kodo liver.

angles.text: As a cook, you may hesitate to use saliva glands, but inventive brewmasters prize strange animal essences for their zest and potency.
As a member of the Horde, you can prove yourself by hunting fierce thunderhawks across the Barrens as you travel through Kalimdor.
